name: species-trajectory
cmd: set -e; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep040 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep040 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep100 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep100 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep130 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep130 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep160 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep160 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep200 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep200 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep300 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep300 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep490 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_ep490 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_swa100_160 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_swa100_160 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_swa300_490 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_traj_swa300_490 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_aug2 --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_aug2 --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1; SCORE_TARGETS=dev bash research/bin/score_both.sh {python} {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_aug2_late --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_aug2_late --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_late
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do f=$d/fair_rivals_incr_p96dev.json; [ -f $f ] || continue; {python} -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); m=r['models']; s=r['space_level']; v=r.get('vs_ref',{}); h=r.get('head_to_head',{}); g=lambda d: '%+.3f [%+.3f,%+.3f]' % (d['diff'], *d['ci']); print(sys.argv[2][:30].ljust(30), 'desk_within %.3f strong %.3f placebo %.3f' % (m['desk_within']['corr'], m['strong']['corr'], m['placebo_300']['corr']), '| vs strong', g(h['desk_within - strong']) if 'desk_within - strong' in h else '-', '| vs ref', g(v['desk_within - desk_ref_within']) if 'desk_within - desk_ref_within' in v else '-', '| space %.4f' % s['desk_pooled'])" $f $(basename $d); done
note: E059b: out-of-community species, E055a trajectory states and masking
